text:
Jordan: Quick sync — we've seen a few tenant spikes where our KV cache spills all at once and causes a TPU-tail latency blip. thinking about a staggered spill policy vs bulk eviction. pros/cons?
Maya: Staggered seems promising for smoothing tail latency. but we need a way to respect tenant SLAs and not let low-priority tenants slow down high-priority ones.
Praveen: +1. suggest a per-tenant token-bucket that gates spill rate. give premium tenants higher refill or emergency tokens to bypass the queue.
Sam: Token-bucket is fine but implementation complexity increases. also we need correct accounting: spilled bytes vs recompute cost. spilling cheap tensors is fine, spilling expensive activations kills request latency.
Maya: we should attach an estimated recompute_cost to residency metadata. policy can prefer spilling low-cost items first. cheap heuristic: size * memory_pressure_factor / expected_recompute_ms.
Jordan: good. how do we schedule the stagger? fixed window, jittered windows, or priority-ordered waterfall?
Praveen: proposal: stagger_window_ms (default 200ms), max_concurrent_spills per-node, and a tenant-urgency flag. algorithm: when pressure crosses threshold, enqueue candidates; pop by (urgency_score, recompute_cost) and issue up to max_concurrent_spills with jittered start times in window.
Sam: sounds workable. need escape hatch — immediate hard-evict if OOM imminent. define hard_threshold > soft_threshold. soft triggers staggered policy; hard forces full eviction.
Maya: agree. also add cooldown per-tenant to avoid thrashing. cooldown_ms default 1000ms.
Praveen: sample config snippet:
```
spill_policy: 
  soft_threshold_percent: 72
  hard_threshold_percent: 90
  stagger_window_ms: 200
  max_concurrent_spills: 4
  tenant_token_buckets:
    premium: {rate: 8MB/s, burst: 32MB, emergency_tokens: 2}
    standard: {rate: 2MB/s, burst: 8MB}
  cooldown_ms: 1000
  recompute_cost_weight: 1.5
```
Jordan: good. what telemetry do we need to validate?
Sam: per-spill latency, spill_bytes, spill_duration, pre/post tail P99 for affected tenants, spill_queue_length, emergency_evictions_count.
Maya: add a metric for "tenant_spill_urgency" and a histogram for recompute_cost_estimate.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled for 2 nodes in prod-staging at 16:00 UTC. Automated rollback on >3x baseline tail-latency.
Praveen: dev plan: implement token-bucket + scheduler in offload controller; recompute-cost estimator in residency service; policy engine to be feature-flagged.
Jordan: risks: complexity of cross-service contracts and estimator accuracy. mitigation: land simple default that falls back to LRU ordering if estimator unavailable.
Sam: also consider tenant fairness long-term: tracking cumulative spill debt and aging to avoid starvation.
Maya: next steps: write short RFC summarizing alg + config + metrics. I'll draft and assign to eng-runtime.
Jordan: thanks — @Maya please ping when RFC is ready. we'll schedule a 30m follow-up after canary results. :thumbsup:
